environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a private subnet with NAT gateway. Task role has s3:PutObject and s3:GetObject on the invoice bucket. The container runs as root with default network configuration. No input validation layer or WAF in front of the ALB. The libxmljs version is 0.19.7 which supports external entity resolution when noent is true.

config.network: Private subnet with NAT gateway for outbound internet
config.container: runs as root, no seccomp profile
config.load_balancer: ALB with no WAF attached, direct passthrough
